name: q8_fly_reservoir_routed
parent_line: fly-connectome ladder (routing enforced v2: separated surfaces)
purpose: The minimal system in which transport is NECESSARY by construction: language tokens enter ONLY through the 15,912 annotated sensory neurons, and the readout sees ONLY the 149,210 non-injected (interneuron/output) neurons. Write surface and read surface are disjoint; every bit of task information must physically traverse the frozen signed wiring between them. Both probes that proved wiring inertness at level 0/0.5 (node relabel, zero transmission) now attack the only pathway.

training.trained: sensory input projection (128->15,912), interneuron weighted readout (149,210->128), tied embedding

falsifiable_expectation: If gradient descent can learn routing through the frozen evolved wiring, NLL descends below the ~7.7 unigram-ish floor and the wiring perturbation probes (relabel/zero/sign-flip) produce large NONZERO deltas - the transport-collision synergy signature. If NLL plateaus at the unigram level (~7.7-8.0) with near-zero deltas, gradient descent cannot discover routing in a frozen biological topology at this budget - the headline negative result for the 'direct brain' approach.
